purpose_pt: Preparação de arte da seleção aprovada, sem implementação da tela.

assets.prompt: Generate ONE isolated blank PLANT SELECTION CARD skin extracted/reconstructed from the approved screenshot reference. This is a production game UI asset, NOT another screenshot or a mockup. Match the UNSELECTED Orquídea card in the bottom middle of the reference as faithfully as possible: broad landscape rectangle about 1.65 width : 1 height, warm orange-brown wooden outside rails, gold bolt heads at all FOUR corners, thin dark forest-green inner keyline, a modest green leaf sprig overlapping upper-left corner and a second small leaf sprig at lower-right corner. Cream parchment opaque interior. Include the same EMPTY wide horizontal nameplate inset near the top, outlined in fine warm brown with small stepped decorative corner marks. Below the nameplate: a blank large LEFT region for a sprite, a thin subdued vertical divider at about 49 percent of card width from 34 percent to 70 percent of height, a blank RIGHT region for three stat lines. Near lower-right, include the same small EMPTY cream status/action plate with shallow clipped pixel corners and fine brown outline. No button at lower-left. Absolutely remove ALL plant sprites, text, numbers, leaf number badges, arrows, statistics and selection indicators. Keep all remaining geometry identical to the approved card design. Flat pixel-art game asset with crisp deliberately stepped edges and broad color clusters matching the reference, restrained 2-4 tone shading; not realistic wood grain, not a modern rounded UI card, no blur, no glow, no drop shadow extending into transparent margin. Center one full card with generous genuinely TRANSPARENT padding all around, never crop corners or leaves; outside silhouette is alpha zero and INSIDE parchment remains opaque. Target the geometry of an approximately 350x210 logical-pixel card at the game's 1280x720 viewport, authored larger without changing proportions. Output ONE blank unselected card only, no multiple states, no surrounding scene, no watermark, no text, no baked checkerboard. Reference image is visual grounding, not content to copy into the interior.

Edit this exact blank selection-card asset into its SELECTED state for Plants x Plants. STRICT GEOMETRY LOCK: retain the SAME canvas size and aspect ratio, SAME transparent margins, SAME outside silhouette, same wood rails, all four gold pins, leaf positions and sizes, same top empty nameplate, same vertical divider and same lower-right empty status plate, pixel for pixel wherever possible. Change ONLY the large parchment body area to a subtle light SAGE GREEN tint matching selected cards in the approved screen, and change the little lower-right status plate fill and outline to a slightly stronger pale olive-green chosen-state treatment. Keep the top nameplate a warm cream for contrast. The tint is gentle light yellow-green parchment, NOT dark green, neon green or solid saturated fill. Preserve shading clusters and crisp pixel-art edges. Do not add selection numbers, leaf badges, plants, text, letters, digits, icons, ticks or arrows; these are separate dynamic layers later. Preserve the existing true alpha transparency outside the card; all parchment inside stays opaque. Absolutely do not redesign, move, stretch or simplify any decorative frame element. One single selected blank card asset, not a mockup, no scene, no watermark.

Create ONE transparent FOCUS OUTLINE OVERLAY for the exact card in the attached image. The attachment is the geometry reference, NOT the content to retain. Keep the SAME canvas dimensions, SAME padding and SAME card exterior silhouette. The output must contain ONLY a thin sharply pixelated AMBER/GOLD outer highlight tracing the outside edge of the card's stepped rectangular perimeter, approximately the 2-3 logical-pixel warm golden focus rim seen around the focused Cacto card in the approved style. Two narrow concentric hard-edged golden/yellow-orange pixel lines are enough. EVERYTHING ELSE must be fully TRANSPARENT, including the entire interior, header, stat area, status area, wood, leaves and pins: they belong to a separate base layer and must not appear in this overlay. Do NOT redraw a card, do NOT fill the rectangle, do NOT add corners, bolts, leaves, particles, glow, arrows, text, shadows or additional ornaments. The overlay is a reusable hollow clipped-corner rectangular pixel outline; approximately 1.65:1 width/height; place it EXACTLY at the original card exterior bounds so it can be composited over either the cream or sage card asset. Genuine alpha transparency inside AND outside the narrow outline. No black rectangle, no white rectangle, no checkerboard baked into pixels. Single isolated game UI overlay, no mockup, no watermark.

Generate ONE standalone EMPTY wooden footer-button skin for the approved Plants x Plants selection-screen redesign. The screenshot is the authoritative visual reference: reconstruct the exact 'Confirmar equipe · ENTER' button at bottom-right but REMOVE all writing. Warm orange-brown pixel-art wooden frame with clipped stepped outer corners, four small golden corner pins, thin dark green inner border, opaque pale cream parchment center, one tiny green leaf cluster at top-left and another at bottom-right. Wide horizontal rectangle about 5.4:1 width to height, shallow wooden rails so future pixel-font text has room. Center a single full button on genuinely TRANSPARENT canvas with generous alpha padding outside all edges; do not crop any foliage or corner. A single uninterrupted completely EMPTY cream writing area: no words, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no divider, no extra inner label plaque, no cursor. Same chunky stepped pixel edges and simple shade clusters as screenshot, never smooth vector shapes or realistic wood texture. No scene, no character, no collage, no watermark, no baked checkerboard. One reusable button sprite that can later be rendered at different widths with protected endcaps, for both Voltar and Confirmar.

Generate ONE isolated small LEAF BADGE game UI icon from the approved Plants x Plants screenshot. Recreate the tilted green leaf carrying selection numbers in the TOP card nameplates, but leave the leaf completely BLANK: no number, no letter, no checkmark, no writing. One plump simple pointed leaf, horizontal with tip pointing up-right, slightly diagonal approximately 25 degrees, dark olive pixel outline, moss/olive green base with 2-3 stepped shades and a small light-green angular highlight near upper-left, a subtle short stem at bottom-left. The center must be broad, calm and dark enough for a cream digit 1, 2 or 3 to be drawn later; avoid prominent veins running through the numeral area. Match the cozy botanical chunky pixel-art style and leaf shape in the screenshot; this is an UI badge, NOT a realistic botanical illustration or a plant character. One single leaf only, no face, no cluster, no scene, no other icons, no glow, no external shadow, no text, no watermark. Center icon at about 65 percent canvas width with generous genuine alpha transparency on ALL sides, outside silhouette fully transparent. Readable as a 32x24 logical-pixel icon at game scale.

Generate ONE tiny isolated right-pointing triangular cursor UI sprite for the approved Plants x Plants selection screenshot. Match exactly the small orange triangle to the LEFT of the focused Cacto card: a filled RIGHT-POINTING orange triangle, with thin pale cream/yellow inner highlight and a thin deep brown outer pixel border, a small brighter golden upper-left edge. Shape is a single solid broad triangular arrowhead only, no shaft, no chevron, no leaf, no circle. Deliberately stepped square pixel edges, limited 4-color warm palette, flat simple game UI pixel art, no gradient, no texture, no glow, no shadow. Entire image genuinely TRANSPARENT except the single arrow. Center the arrow in the canvas, generous transparent padding, all corners visible. Its intended logical size is about 22 pixels wide by 28 pixels tall. No plant, no card, no text, no numerals, no multiple arrows, no sheet, no background, no watermark. A simple original pixel cursor, not a glossy 3D button.
